newsitem.title: INDONESIA: Indonesia 1996 soybean output seen down 100,000T.
newsitem.headline: Indonesia 1996 soybean output seen down 100,000T.

text.p: Indonesia's soybean production is expected to fall by 100,000 tonnes this year from 1.6 million tonnes in 1995, the Harian Ekonomic Neraca newspaper reported on Wednesday.

Soemitro Arintadisastra of the directorate-general of Food Crops and Horticulture was quoted as saying the drop was due to a decrease in the area under soybean cultivation by 100,000 hectares this year from 1.4 million hectares in 1995.
He said 60 percent of domestic soybean production came from the densely populated island of Java, adding that national output per hectare averaged 1.5 tonnes.
President Suharto said on Monday there was a need to set up soybean plantations to meet the domestic import demand of 600,000 tonnes per year.
